title: Misting System Missed Cycle Alert
dataSources: Apex controller readings (`apex:reading`), Seneye measurements (`seneye:reading`), reptile thermostat events (`reptilethermostat:event`), and misting-system cycles (`mister:cycle`).
app: Aquarium and terrarium telemetry from Neptune Apex, Seneye, reptile thermostats, and misting systems sent to Splunk HEC via controller APIs, MQTT, and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mister:cycle
| search cycle_status="completed"
| stats latest(_time) as last_seen count as events by zone_name
| eval hours_since=round((now()-last_seen)/3600,1)
| sort - hours_since
description: Shows which zoness have gone quiet for misting cycles.
value: A missed misting cycle is often the earliest visible failure in a humidity-dependent enclosure.
implementation: Send misting cycles events to `index=personal` and alert when the gap since the last event grows beyond the expected cadence.
visualization: Table of zoness with time since last event.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors which zoness have gone quiet longer than they should for misting cycles.
